fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (50%: NTM EPS at Sep-2027 ~$6.30 x 44x = $277), EV/sales (25%: NTM sales ~$8.3B x 8x + ~$2.45B equity-adjusted net cash over ~323M diluted shares = $212) and a 10-year DCF (25%: $122, WACC 10.5%, 3.5% terminal growth, 24% steady-state operating margin). Weighted value ~$222, about 23% below the $288.7 close.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: FY2026 consensus EPS $2.71 and FY2027 consensus $4.93 (28 analysts, range $2.95-$7.01); FY2028 EPS ~$6.9 (+40%) is MY extrapolation, not consensus (no FY28 consensus exists). NTM EPS as of Sep-2027 ~$6.30 (conservatively weighted) x 44x. Multiple trimmed from 45x so the leg is consistent with the base scenario (~43-44x NTM) and the 25x bear multiple; still a premium to GEV/VRT-type AI-power peers for ~35-40% growth.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: NTM revenue at Sep-2027 ~$8.3B (FY27 consensus $6.79B, FY28E ~$9.0B my extrapolation) x 8x EV/sales = $66.4B; + ~$2.45B equity-adjusted net cash ($2.67B cash at 6/30/26 less ~$0.2B financing obligations; the ~$2.475B of 0% 2030 converts at ~$194.97 conversion are deep in the money and already in the diluted count); / ~323M diluted shares

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: Revenue 2028-2034: $9.0B, 11.5B, 14.0B, 16.5B, 18.5B, 20.0B, 21.0B; operating margin 22%->24%; tax 21%; FCF = 85% of NOPAT; WACC 10.5%; terminal growth 3.5%; +$2.45B net cash; 323M diluted shares. Shows the current price needs revenue well beyond $20B or higher margins / a lower discount rate; weighted only 25% because terminal economics of on-site AI power are hard to pin down.

bear.story: Project Jupiter slips materially (air-quality permit denied or delayed past the Nov 23, 2026 deadline and/or the Green Chile pipeline slips well past Feb 1, 2027, with no redeployment of units to other Oracle sites), hyperscaler capex cools or gas-turbine lead times ease, and scandium/China sourcing, the class action or stack-life questions weigh; FY27 guide lands well below ~$6.8B, the multiple compresses to ~25x on EPS of ~$5 and the S&P-inclusion/momentum bid unwinds.

base.story: Company delivers roughly consensus (FY26 rev ~$4.1B, FY27 ~$6.8B, EPS ~$4.9) with gross margins ~34-35%; Jupiter is a timing issue for part of 2027 revenue rather than a backlog loss (financing-partner purchase terms allow shipment even if the site slips; more than half of the >=$8B equipment backlog is non-Oracle). Earnings growth roughly offsets de-rating from ~59x to ~43x NTM, so the stock ends near today's level with large swings.

bull.story: Jupiter permit granted on schedule, Oracle 2.8 GW MSA and the Brookfield $25B framework convert faster, more direct hyperscaler MSAs are signed, the FY27 guide lands above $7.5B with EPS toward the $7 high estimate, and the market keeps a 60x+ AI-power multiple.

thesis_break_reason: About 45% below spot and below the ~$164 post-Q2 low, $160 is ~32x FY27 consensus EPS of $4.93 for a company guiding ~100% growth. A trade there would most likely mean the growth story broke rather than ordinary volatility: a FY27 guide in Feb 2027 well below ~$6.8B revenue, Project Jupiter actually cancelled or pushed past 2028 (permit denied, pipeline slipping well past Feb 2027) without redeployment, other gigawatt-scale contracts (Oracle, Aligned, Brookfield) lost or delayed, gross margin back under ~30% from sourcing or tariff issues, or loss of the 48E credit. I keep $160 rather than a lower level because with 112% realized vol the $170-230 zone is noise, but sustained trading under $160 needs estimate cuts.

Whether AI-power multiples hold: the stock trades ~59x FY27 consensus EPS and ~22x EV/sales

reasoning: Round 2 update. The supervisor's fact-checks confirmed my convert treatment (~$195 conversion, shares already in the 323.3M diluted count) but showed my ~$3B cash was high: 6/30/26 cash was $2.67B less ~$0.2B financing obligations, so ~$2.45B net cash (-$1.7/share in the EV/sales and DCF legs). I also trimmed the P/E leg multiple from 45x to 44x so it is consistent with my base scenario (~43x) and bear multiple, and now label my $6.9 FY28 EPS as my own extrapolation (FY27 consensus $4.93, range $2.95-$7.01, rising). Blended fair value moves from $227 to $222 (P/E $277, EV/sales $212, DCF $122), still well below spot. On Jupiter, follow-up searches confirmed the supervisor: Oracle's notice runs to developer Blue Owl, Oracle/Blue Owl say the project is on track, Bloom says the 2.4 GW contract stands, Morgan Stanley (Overweight, $310) says Jupiter is outside Bloom's 2026 forecast and equipment backlog is >=$8B with more than half non-Oracle, and the NM Supreme Court lifted stays on the permit process (hearing was moved up to Sep 14, decision due Nov 23). That makes Jupiter more a timing risk than a backlog-loss risk, so I cut the bear weight from 0.28 to 0.26, while adding the Nov 23 permit as a dated binary. Base rates are unchanged: 112% realized vol; I assume ~65% forward vol. The median moves up slightly from ~$268 to ~$272 (Jupiter clarification plus continued estimate and target raises: UBS $325, Clear Street $330, Mizuho $351), still just below spot because de-rating from ~59x toward ~43x absorbs most of the earnings growth and the index-inclusion bid is spent. The ladder is ~lognormal (median ~$272, sigma ~0.65) with a slightly fatter left tail for thesis failure. The supervisor noted my 5% at $722 was thinner than my own lognormal (~6.7%); that was partly unintentional, so I raised it to 6% and $577 to 12%, keeping a small haircut because reaching $722 (~100x FY27 EPS) needs both beats and multiple expansion. Scenario-weighted mean ~$288. P(>=$289) = 0.462 (was 0.455).
